title: Georgia property tax millage rates
description: Every taxing jurisdiction's millage rate, tax levied and assessed value, by county and tax district, for each published tax year.
updateCadence: Polled monthly; the source changes once a year, when DOR publishes a new tax year's workbook.
source: Georgia Department of Revenue, Local Government Services — Tax Digest Consolidated Summaries (https://dor.georgia.gov/local-government-services/digest-compliance/digest-consolidated-summaries)
